title: GitHub - kenobi-ai/breamer: A resilient multi-instance Chrome service running entirely on Cloudflare Workers.
excerpt: A resilient multi-instance Chrome service running entirely on Cloudflare Workers. - kenobi-ai/breamer
content_html:
Fresh Google Chrome Stable containers on Cloudflare, exposed as long-lived Puppeteer-compatible CDP sessions.

Breamer gives you a self-contained browser environment for remote automation. Send one authenticated request to the Worker, get back a WebSocket endpoint, connect with Puppeteer, then call the returned shutdown URL when the job is finished.

No shared singleton browser. No public root page. No global shutdown button. Each authorized /cdp request gets its own named Cloudflare Container session.

What It Ships

  • A Cloudflare Worker that authenticates session creation.
  • A Cloudflare Container running Bun, Hono, Puppeteer, and official Google Chrome Stable.
  • A session-scoped CDP proxy, so Puppeteer connects through the Worker URL.
  • A returned shutdown URL for that one browser session.
  • A 5 minute container sleep horizon for jobs that fail to clean up.
  • standard-4 container sizing, configured Chrome heap/window settings, Mac Chrome-like page defaults, SwiftShader/ANGLE software graphics, a curated desktop/web font base, browser font aliases, and structured browser lifecycle logs.
  • CDP-level pre-capture settling for Page.captureSnapshot, so MHTML archives wait briefly for DOM readiness, fonts, image decodes, idle time, dynamic media rasterization, and compositor frames before capture.
  • Structured request, session, browser, CDP proxy, auth, health, and shutdown logs across Worker and container.

Flow

sequenceDiagram
  participant Caller
  participant Worker
  participant Container
  participant Chrome

  Caller->>Worker: GET /cdp + bearer token
  Worker->>Container: start named session container
  Container->>Chrome: launch or verify browser
  Container-->>Caller: wsEndpoint + shutdownUrl + sessionId
  Caller->>Worker: Puppeteer connects to /sessions/:id/cdp/...
  Worker->>Container: proxy CDP WebSocket
  Container->>Chrome: proxy CDP frames
  Caller->>Worker: POST returned shutdownUrl
  Worker->>Container: shutdown that session
Loading

Local Parity

Local development uses Wrangler plus the same Dockerfile Cloudflare deploys.

bun install
cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars
bun run dev

Wrangler usually serves the Worker at http://localhost:8787.

Fetch a browser session:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer dev-secret" http://localhost:8787/cdp

Response:

{
  "wsEndpoint": "ws://localhost:8787/sessions/00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2/cdp/devtools/browser/96a96c29-36ad-47da-be46-35249f44dc66",
  "shutdownUrl": "http://localhost:8787/sessions/00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2/shutdown",
  "sessionId": "00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2",
  "mode": "proxy",
  "path": "/sessions/00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2/cdp/devtools/browser/96a96c29-36ad-47da-be46-35249f44dc66",
  "localPath": "/devtools/browser/96a96c29-36ad-47da-be46-35249f44dc66"
}

Connect from Puppeteer:

import puppeteer from "puppeteer";

const response = await fetch(`${process.env.BREAMER_ROOT_URL}/cdp`, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN}`
  }
});

if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(await response.text());
}

const { wsEndpoint, shutdownUrl } = await response.json() as {
  wsEndpoint: string;
  shutdownUrl: string;
};

const browser = await puppeteer.connect({
  browserWSEndpoint: wsEndpoint,
  defaultViewport: null
});

try {
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  await page.goto("https://example.com", { waitUntil: "networkidle0" });
} finally {
  browser.disconnect();
  await fetch(shutdownUrl, { method: "POST" });
}

Capture an MHTML archive through the live CDP service:

bun run capture:mhtml -- --live-url https://example.com --token "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN"

By default this calls https://breamer.kenobi.ai/cdp and writes the archive under mhtml-archives/. It also prints the live browser fingerprint used for the capture, including user agent, client hints, locale, timezone, viewport, screen, and media-query values. To point at another Breamer root URL:

bun run capture:mhtml -- https://breamer.example.com "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN" https://example.com

Useful knobs:

bun run capture:mhtml -- \
  --service-url https://breamer.example.com \
  --token "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  --url https://example.com \
  --wait-for-selector main \
  --viewport 1440x900 \
  --out-dir mhtml-archives

Compare Breamer against an already-running local Mac Chrome:

bun run compare:rendering -- \
  --service-url https://breamer.example.com \
  --token "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  --url https://example.com \
  --reference-http http://127.0.0.1:9222

Start your reference Chrome yourself with remote debugging enabled, then pass either --reference-http or --reference-ws. The helper writes paired PNG screenshots and a JSON report under render-comparisons/, including pixel-diff metrics and browser fingerprint differences. It never launches the reference browser for you.

Do not use Wrangler's temporary *.trycloudflare.com tunnel as the CDP parity test. It is fine for HTTP checks, but WebSocket upgrade behavior can differ. Use http://localhost:8787 locally and a real deployed Worker URL publicly.

Deploy

Set the Worker secret:

bunx wrangler secret put BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN

Deploy:

bun run deploy

Dry run the Worker and container build:

bun run dry-run

wrangler.jsonc pins this project to Cloudflare account 6f735f3e89aec8751cf8ad7ed37cae12 and custom domain breamer.kenobi.ai.

API

Endpoint Auth Description
GET /cdp or POST /cdp Bearer token Creates a fresh named container session and returns wsEndpoint, shutdownUrl, and sessionId.
GET /sessions/:sessionId/cdp/... Session URL possession CDP WebSocket route used by Puppeteer.
POST /sessions/:sessionId/shutdown Session URL possession Stops that specific browser container.
GET /health or GET /_worker/health Bearer token Worker health/config check. Does not wake a container.
GET /sessions/:sessionId/health Bearer token Container health check.
GET /sessions/:sessionId/ready Bearer token Verifies Chrome is ready inside that session.

/ intentionally returns 404.

Configuration

Secret:

BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN=<long random token>

Shutdown URLs do not require the bearer token. They are high-entropy session capabilities returned only from an authorized /cdp call.

Logging

Worker logs are structured JSON with requestId, route, status, duration, session ID, and container lifecycle events.

Container logs include:

  • boot configuration
  • request method/path/status/duration
  • auth failures
  • session ID and request ID
  • browser launch and disconnects
  • target/page lifecycle
  • console errors and page errors
  • CDP proxy connect/open/close/error
  • endpoint issuance
  • readiness, health, and shutdown

The Worker forwards x-breamer-request-id into the container, so a single job can be followed across both layers.

Archive Quality Notes

Breamer starts a Mac Chrome-like default browser: high-DPI desktop viewport, macOS user agent and client hints, Chrome-shaped Accept-Language, Europe/London timezone, MacIntel navigator platform, desktop hardware/memory buckets, P3 color-gamut media, light color scheme, normal motion preference, screen media, active/focused page state, and no-touch desktop metrics. Callers can still override these per page.

Breamer automatically settles pages before proxied Page.captureSnapshot calls. The settle step waits for DOM readiness, document.fonts.ready, pending image decodes, CSS image URLs, pseudo-element images, mask images, idle time, and a few compositor frames. It also best-effort inlines readable @font-face font URLs as data: URLs before capture, so MHTML archives do not depend on Chrome preserving external font resources. After snapshot capture, Breamer scans the MHTML for remaining external font URLs and embeds missing font files as font/* MHTML parts with matching Content-Location headers, which covers cross-origin stylesheets that page JavaScript cannot fetch because of CORS. If a matching family/weight/style face is already present as an inline data: font, Breamer leaves that inline face alone instead of adding a duplicate archive part. It briefly scrolls through the page to trigger lazy-loaded content, traverses open shadow roots for images and dynamic media, then restores the scroll position. Before capture, it converts parser-unsafe paragraphs that contain tags such as div, section, lists, headings, or tables into visually equivalent div containers, so JavaScript-created split text can round-trip through MHTML without the HTML parser auto-closing the paragraph. It also replaces readable canvas elements and current video frames with PNG images so MHTML archives do not lose dynamic pixels. If the settle step fails or times out, capture still proceeds and the event is logged.

The container image runs official Google Chrome Stable, includes Mesa/Vulkan/GL libraries for Chrome's software graphics path, and installs a curated high-coverage font base instead of vendoring Google Fonts or every Debian fonts-* package. The font set keeps metric-compatible Office/core web fonts, Noto core/CJK/emoji coverage, common UI fonts, code fonts, Material Icons, and Font Awesome. Fontconfig aliases map common proprietary stacks such as Arial, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Courier New, Georgia, Verdana, Tahoma, Consolas, Calibri, Cambria, Segoe UI, SF Pro, Material Icons, Font Awesome, and Apple/Segoe emoji to available metric-compatible fonts.

Callers still own page-specific capture correctness. Before Page.captureSnapshot, set any target-specific viewport, user agent, locale/media, and wait policy your archive needs.

For MHTML capture, a good caller sequence is:

  1. Connect with defaultViewport: null.
  2. Create a page and set the viewport you want.
  3. Set user agent and extra headers if the target site is sensitive to them.
  4. Navigate with a settled wait strategy.
  5. Wait for app-specific async work that only the caller understands.
  6. Capture MHTML.
  7. Call the returned shutdown URL.

For visual parity work, use bun run compare:rendering against a real local Mac Chrome remote-debugging endpoint. The screenshot diff will not explain every browser-layout choice, but it gives a tight loop for finding concrete remaining gaps instead of judging archives by eye.

Docker

Wrangler builds this image automatically:

docker build -t breamer .

If you run the raw container directly, pass the same required container env vars the Worker injects: PAGE_TIMEOUT_MS, CHROME_HEAP_SIZE_MB, BROWSER_WIDTH, BROWSER_HEIGHT, BROWSER_DEVICE_SCALE_FACTOR, BROWSER_LOCALE, BROWSER_PLATFORM, BROWSER_CLIENT_HINT_PLATFORM, BROWSER_CLIENT_HINT_ARCHITECTURE, BROWSER_CLIENT_HINT_PLATFORM_VERSION, BROWSER_COLOR_GAMUT, BROWSER_HARDWARE_CONCURRENCY, BROWSER_DEVICE_MEMORY_GB, BROWSER_PREFERS_COLOR_SCHEME, BROWSER_PREFERS_REDUCED_MOTION, BROWSER_TIMEZONE, ARCHIVE_SETTLE_BEFORE_CAPTURE, ARCHIVE_AUTO_SCROLL_BEFORE_CAPTURE, ARCHIVE_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS, and ARCHIVE_RASTERIZE_DYNAMIC_MEDIA.

Checks

bun run check

check regenerates Wrangler Worker types, typechecks the Worker and Bun container code, runs tests, checks formatting/linting with Biome, checks unused files/dependencies with Knip, and runs the repo-local pokayoke policy so the service stays private Cloudflare infrastructure.

There is no separate application build step. Wrangler compiles the Worker for dev/deploy, and the container image runs src/server.ts directly on Bun.

blocks.html_en: Breamer automatically settles pages before proxied Page.captureSnapshot calls. The settle step waits for DOM readiness, document.fonts.ready, pending image decodes, CSS image URLs, pseudo-element images, mask images, idle time, and a few compositor frames. It also best-effort inlines readable @font-face font URLs as data: URLs before capture, so MHTML archives do not depend on Chrome preserving external font resources. After snapshot capture, Breamer scans the MHTML for remaining external font URLs and embeds missing font files as font/* MHTML parts with matching Content-Location headers, which covers cross-origin stylesheets that page JavaScript cannot fetch because of CORS. If a matching family/weight/style face is already present as an inline data: font, Breamer leaves that inline face alone instead of adding a duplicate archive part. It briefly scrolls through the page to trigger lazy-loaded content, traverses open shadow roots for images and dynamic media, then restores the scroll position. Before capture, it converts parser-unsafe paragraphs that contain tags such as div, section, lists, headings, or tables into visually equivalent div containers, so JavaScript-created split text can round-trip through MHTML without the HTML parser auto-closing the paragraph. It also replaces readable canvas elements and current video frames with PNG images so MHTML archives do not lose dynamic pixels. If the settle step fails or times out, capture still proceeds and the event is logged.

content_html_zh:
Cloudflare 上的新 Google Chrome 稳定版容器，公开为长期存在的、与 Puppeteer 兼容的 CDP 会话。

Breamer 为您提供了一个用于远程自动化的独立浏览器环境。 向 Worker 发送一个经过身份验证的请求，获取 WebSocket 端点，与 Puppeteer 连接，然后在作业完成时调用返回的关闭 URL。

没有共享的单例浏览器。 没有公共根页面。 没有全局关闭按钮。 每个授权的 /cdp 请求都会获得自己的命名 Cloudflare Container 会话。

运送什么

  • 对会话创建进行身份验证的 Cloudflare Worker。
  • 运行 Bun、Hono、Puppeteer 和官方 Google Chrome 稳定版的 Cloudflare 容器。
  • 会话范围的 CDP 代理，因此 Puppeteer 通过 Worker URL 进行连接。
  • 该浏览器会话返回的关闭 URL。
  • 对于无法清理的作业，容器睡眠时间为 5 分钟。
  • 标准 4 容器大小、配置的 Chrome 堆/窗口设置、类似 Mac Chrome 的页面默认值、SwiftShader/ANGLE 软件图形、精心策划的桌面/Web 字体库、浏览器字体别名和结构化浏览器生命周期日志。
  • CDP 级预捕获解决了 Page.captureSnapshot，因此 MHTML 存档在捕获之前会短暂等待 DOM 准备就绪、字体、图像解码、空闲时间、动态媒体光栅化和合成器帧。
  • 跨 Worker 和容器的结构化请求、会话、浏览器、CDP 代理、身份验证、运行状况和关闭日志。

Flow

sequenceDiagram
  participant Caller
  participant Worker
  participant Container
  participant Chrome

  Caller->>Worker: GET /cdp + bearer token
  Worker->>Container: start named session container
  Container->>Chrome: launch or verify browser
  Container-->>Caller: wsEndpoint + shutdownUrl + sessionId
  Caller->>Worker: Puppeteer connects to /sessions/:id/cdp/...
  Worker->>Container: proxy CDP WebSocket
  Container->>Chrome: proxy CDP frames
  Caller->>Worker: POST returned shutdownUrl
  Worker->>Container: shutdown that session
Loading

本地平价

本地开发使用 Wrangler 以及 Cloudflare 部署的相同 Dockerfile。

bun install
cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars
bun run dev

Wrangler 通常通过 http://localhost:8787 为 Worker 提供服务。

获取浏览器会话：

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer dev-secret" http://localhost:8787/cdp

回复：

{
  "wsEndpoint": "ws://localhost:8787/sessions/00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2/cdp/devtools/browser/96a96c29-36ad-47da-be46-35249f44dc66",
  "shutdownUrl": "http://localhost:8787/sessions/00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2/shutdown",
  "sessionId": "00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2",
  "mode": "proxy",
  "path": "/sessions/00382bb3-25dd-433c-bce4-495dd0438ea2/cdp/devtools/browser/96a96c29-36ad-47da-be46-35249f44dc66",
  "localPath": "/devtools/browser/96a96c29-36ad-47da-be46-35249f44dc66"
}

从 Puppeteer 连接：

import puppeteer from "puppeteer";

const response = await fetch(`${process.env.BREAMER_ROOT_URL}/cdp`, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN}`
  }
});

if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(await response.text());
}

const { wsEndpoint, shutdownUrl } = await response.json() as {
  wsEndpoint: string;
  shutdownUrl: string;
};

const browser = await puppeteer.connect({
  browserWSEndpoint: wsEndpoint,
  defaultViewport: null
});

try {
  const page = await browser.newPage();
  await page.goto("https://example.com", { waitUntil: "networkidle0" });
} finally {
  browser.disconnect();
  await fetch(shutdownUrl, { method: "POST" });
}

通过实时 CDP 服务捕获 MHTML 存档：

bun run capture:mhtml -- --live-url https://example.com --token "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN"

默认情况下，这会调用 https://breamer.kenobi.ai/cdp 并将存档写入 mhtml-archives/ 下。 它还打印用于捕获的实时浏览器指纹，包括用户代理、客户端提示、区域设置、时区、视口、屏幕和媒体查询值。 指向另一个 Breamer 根 URL：

bun run capture:mhtml -- https://breamer.example.com "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN" https://example.com

有用的旋钮：

bun run capture:mhtml -- \
  --service-url https://breamer.example.com \
  --token "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  --url https://example.com \
  --wait-for-selector main \
  --viewport 1440x900 \
  --out-dir mhtml-archives

将 Breamer 与已运行的本地 Mac Chrome 进行比较：

bun run compare:rendering -- \
  --service-url https://breamer.example.com \
  --token "$BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  --url https://example.com \
  --reference-http http://127.0.0.1:9222

在启用远程调试的情况下自行启动参考 Chrome，然后传递 --reference-http 或 --reference-ws。 该帮助程序在 render-comparisons/ 下写入配对的 PNG 屏幕截图和 JSON 报告，包括像素差异指标和浏览器指纹差异。 它永远不会为您启动参考浏览器。

请勿使用 Wrangler 的临时 *.trycloudflare.com 隧道作为 CDP 奇偶校验测试。 对于 HTTP 检查来说没问题，但 WebSocket 升级行为可能会有所不同。 本地使用 http://localhost:8787 并公开实际部署的 Worker URL。

部署

设置工人秘密：

bunx wrangler secret put BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN

部署：

bun run deploy

试运行 Worker 和容器构建：

bun run dry-run

wrangler.jsonc 将此项目固定到 Cloudflare 帐户 6f735f3e89aec8751cf8ad7ed37cae12 和自定义域 braamer.kenobi.ai。

API

端点 Auth 描述
GET /cdp 或 POST /cdp 不记名令牌 创建一个新的命名容器会话并返回 wsEndpoint、shutdownUrl 和 sessionId。
GET /sessions/:sessionId/cdp/... 会话 URL 拥有 Puppeteer 使用的 CDP WebSocket 路由。
POST /sessions/:sessionId/shutdown 会话 URL 拥有 停止该特定的浏览器容器。
GET /health 或 GET /_worker/health 不记名令牌 工作人员健康/配置检查。 不唤醒容器。
GET /sessions/:sessionId/health 不记名令牌 容器健康检查。
GET /sessions/:sessionId/ready 不记名令牌 验证 Chrome 在该会话中已准备就绪。

/ 故意返回404。

配置

非秘密设置位于 wrangler.jsonc 中。

环境 默认 目的
BREAMER_PAGE_TIMEOUT_MS 必需的 容器内的空闲页面清理。
BREAMER_CHROME_HEAP_SIZE_MB 必需的 Chrome V8 堆大小。
BREAMER_BROWSER_WIDTH 必需的 初始浏览器宽度。
BREAMER_BROWSER_HEIGHT 必需的 初始浏览器高度。
BREAMER_BROWSER_DEVICE_SCALE_FACTOR 必需的 初始设备比例因子。
BREAMER_BROWSER_LOCALE 必需的 Chrome 区域设置。
BREAMER_BROWSER_USER_AGENT unset 可选的用户代理覆盖。
BREAMER_BROWSER_PLATFORM 必需的 JavaScript 导航器平台覆盖。
BREAMER_BROWSER_CLIENT_HINT_PLATFORM 必需的 用户代理客户端提示平台。
BREAMER_BROWSER_CLIENT_HINT_ARCHITECTURE 必需的 用户代理客户端提示架构。
BREAMER_BROWSER_CLIENT_HINT_PLATFORM_VERSION 必需的 用户代理客户端提示平台版本。
BREAMER_BROWSER_COLOR_GAMUT 必需的 模拟 CSS 色域。
BREAMER_BROWSER_HARDWARE_CONCURRENCY 必需的 JavaScript 导航器 CPU 线程计数覆盖。
BREAMER_BROWSER_DEVICE_MEMORY_GB 必需的 JavaScript 导航器内存桶覆盖。
BREAMER_BROWSER_PREFERS_COLOR_SCHEME 必需的 模拟首选颜色方案。
BREAMER_BROWSER_PREFERS_REDUCED_MOTION 必需的 模拟偏好减少运动。
BREAMER_BROWSER_TIMEZONE 必需的 模拟浏览器时区。
BREAMER_ARCHIVE_SETTLE_BEFORE_CAPTURE 必需的 在 Page.captureSnapshot 之前启用 CDP 代理设置。
BREAMER_ARCHIVE_AUTO_SCROLL_BEFORE_CAPTURE 必需的 在 MHTML 捕获之前短暂滚动页面以触发延迟加载的内容，然后恢复滚动位置。
BREAMER_ARCHIVE_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS 必需的 字体、图像、空闲时间和合成器帧的最大预捕获等待时间。
BREAMER_ARCHIVE_RASTERIZE_DYNAMIC_MEDIA 必需的 在 MHTML 捕获之前将可读的画布/视频元素替换为 PNG 快照。
BREAMER_SLEEP_AFTER 5m Cloudflare 容器睡眠地平线。

秘密：

BREAMER_ACCESS_TOKEN=<long random token>

关闭 URL 不需要持有者令牌。 它们是仅从授权的 /cdp 调用返回的高熵会话功能。

记录

工作日志是结构化 JSON，包含 requestId、路由、状态、持续时间、会话 ID 和容器生命周期事件。

容器日志包括：

  • 启动配置
  • 请求方法/路径/状态/持续时间
  • 验证失败
  • 会话 ID 和请求 ID
  • 浏览器启动并断开连接
  • 目标/页面生命周期
  • 控制台错误和页面错误
  • CDP 代理连接/打开/关闭/错误
  • 端点发行
  • 准备状态、运行状况和关闭

Worker 将 x-breamer-request-id 转发到容器中，因此可以跨两个层跟踪单个作业。

存档质量说明

Breamer 启动类似 Mac Chrome 的默认浏览器：高 DPI 桌面视口、macOS 用户代理和客户端提示、Chrome 形状的接受语言、欧洲/伦敦时区、MacIntel 导航器平台、桌面硬件/内存桶、P3 色域媒体、浅色方案、正常运动首选项、屏幕媒体、活动/聚焦页面状态和非触摸桌面指标。 呼叫者仍然可以覆盖每页的这些内容。

Breamer 在代理 Page.captureSnapshot 调用之前自动处理页面。 结算步骤等待 DOM 准备就绪、document.fonts.ready、挂起的图像解码、CSS 图像 URL、伪元素图像、遮罩图像、空闲时间和一些合成器帧。 它还会在捕获之前尽力内联可读的 @font-face 字体 URL 作为 data: URL，因此 MHTML 存档不依赖于 Chrome 保留外部字体资源。 捕获快照后，Breamer 会扫描 MHTML 来查找剩余的外部字体 URL，并将缺失的字体文件嵌入为具有匹配 Content-Location 标头的 font/* MHTML 部分，其中涵盖了页面 JavaScript 由于 CORS 而无法获取的跨源样式表。 如果匹配的系列/粗细/样式面已作为内联数据存在：字体，Breamer 会单独保留该内联面，而不是添加重复的存档部分。 它会短暂滚动页面以触发延迟加载的内容，遍历图像和动态媒体的开放阴影根，然后恢复滚动位置。 在捕获之前，它将包含 div、节、列表、标题或表格等标签的解析器不安全段落转换为视觉上等效的 div 容器，因此 JavaScript 创建的拆分文本可以在 MHTML 中往返，而无需 HTML 解析器自动关闭段落。 它还用 PNG 图像替换可读的画布元素和当前视频帧，因此 MHTML 存档不会丢失动态像素。 如果解决步骤失败或超时，捕获仍会继续并记录事件。

该容器映像运行官方 Google Chrome 稳定版，包括用于 Chrome 软件图形路径的 Mesa/Vulkan/GL 库，并安装精选的高覆盖率字体库，而不是供应 Google Fonts 或每个 Debian fonts-* 包。 字体集保留公制兼容的 Office/核心 Web 字体、Noto 核心/CJK/表情符号覆盖、常见 UI 字体、代码字体、Material Icons 和 Font Awesome。 Fontconfig 别名将常见的专有堆栈（例如 Arial、Helvetica、Times New Roman、Courier New、Georgia、Verdana、Tahoma、Consolas、Calibri、Cambria、Segoe UI、SF Pro、Material Icons、Font Awesome 和 Apple/Segoe emoji）映射到可用的公制兼容字体。

调用者仍然拥有特定于页面的捕获正确性。 在 Page.captureSnapshot 之前，设置存档所需的任何特定于目标的视口、用户代理、区域设置/媒体和等待策略。

对于 MHTML 捕获，一个好的调用者序列是：

  1. 连接defaultViewport：null。
  2. 创建一个页面并设置所需的视口。
  3. 如果目标站点对用户代理和额外标头敏感，请设置它们。
  4. 使用固定的等待策略进行导航。
  5. 等待只有调用者才能理解的特定于应用程序的异步工作。
  6. 捕获 MHTML。
  7. 调用返回的关闭URL。

对于视觉奇偶校验工作，请使用 Bun run Compare:rendering 来对比真实的本地 Mac Chrome 远程调试端点。 屏幕截图差异不会解释每个浏览器布局选择，但它提供了一个紧密的循环来查找具体的剩余间隙，而不是通过眼睛判断档案。
